bacterial_blight.cause: High humidity, infected soil, or pests.
bacterial_blight.spread_method: Wind, water splash, or insect vectors.
bacterial_blight.organic_treatment: Apply organic neem-based solutions or copper fungicides. Remove infected plant parts.
bacterial_blight.chemical_treatment: Spray broad-spectrum fungicide or bactericide approved for Rice.
bacterial_blight.safety_precautions: Wear PPE when spraying. Observe pre-harvest intervals.
